name: Apollo
description: Person and company enrichment: find people by title and company, resolve them to verified work emails, and enrich companies from a domain with funding, headcount and technologies.

tools.name: Company enrichment
tools.description: Use when you have a domain and need the company behind it. For a company you can only name, search first: this takes a domain and nothing else.

options.about: Company domain, for example firecrawl.dev. The reliable key: names collide.
options.name: domain

response.about: One company: firmographics, funding, headcount, industry and the technologies it runs. A miss is not billed.

tools.name: Company search
tools.description: Use to build a list from a shape: size, location, industry, technology. It bills per page, so ask for the page size you need rather than paging through the whole market.

options.about: Free text matched against company names and descriptions.
options.name: q_organization_name

options.about: Employee-count bands, for example ["1,10", "11,50"].
options.name: organization_num_employees_ranges

options.about: Locations to restrict to, for example "San Francisco, US".
options.name: organization_locations

options.about: Technologies the company must use, for example ["Stripe"].
options.name: currently_using_any_of_technology_uids

options.about: Page of results, from 1.
options.name: page

options.about: Results per page, maximum 100.
options.name: per_page

response.about: Companies matching the shape asked for, one page at a time.

fields.about: Primary domain, the key companies/enrich takes.
fields.name: primary_domain

tools.name: Person match
tools.description: Use to resolve one person you have already found. Prefer the id from people/search, then a LinkedIn URL, then email; a bare name needs a domain beside it or it will match the wrong person.

options.about: Apollo person id from people/search. The most reliable input by far.
options.name: id

options.about: LinkedIn profile URL. Resolves even when the slug is stale.
options.name: linkedin_url

options.about: Known email address.
options.name: email

options.about: Full name, used with a company domain.
options.name: name

options.about: Company domain, used with a name to disambiguate.
options.name: domain

options.about: Reveal a personal email as well as the work one. Bills extra and is a different consent question: ask for it only when the caller asked for it.
options.name: reveal_personal_emails

options.about: Reveal a phone number. Substantially more expensive than the base match.
options.name: reveal_phone_number

response.about: One resolved person: identity, title, employment history and contact details. A miss returns no person and is not billed.

fields.about: Work email, when one was found.
fields.name: email

tools.name: Person search
tools.description: Always start here. It is free and it tells you who exists before anything is spent. Never match a list of guesses: search, read the previews, then match only the people worth revealing.

options.about: Job titles to match, for example "VP of Sales". Several titles widen the net.
options.name: person_titles

options.about: Free text matched across the person and their company.
options.name: q_keywords

options.about: Company domains to restrict to, for example firecrawl.dev.
options.name: q_organization_domains_list

options.about: Locations to restrict to, for example "San Francisco, US".
options.name: person_locations

options.about: Page of results, from 1.
options.name: page

options.about: Results per page, maximum 100.
options.name: per_page

response.about: Preview records: first name, a masked surname, title, company, and flags for whether an email or phone exists. Each carries an Apollo id, which is what people/match takes.

fields.about: Apollo person id, the input to people/match.
fields.name: id

fields.about: Whether an email exists to reveal.
fields.name: has_email
